clog-1: Mvura yechimbuzi haisi kuenda pasi zvachose uye iri kudurukira kunze
clog-2: Chinhu chisingadiwi (machira akanyorova, bhurasho rezino, chivharo) chapinda muchimbuzi
clog-3: Dhishi rekusukira remukicheni rine munhuwi wakashata uye mvura iri kuungana
clog-4: Mvura iri kudurukira ichibva mupombi yepasi pesink kana pombi yepasi
clog-5: Pombi yepasi pebhavhu yakavharika nebvudzi uye mvura iri kudzoka
clog-6: Dhirini rekuwachira kana revheranda riri kurutsa furo nemvura
clog-7: Pombi huru yetsvina yechivako/vhirah kana mugero yakavharika
clog-9: Kucheneswa kwepombi kuchishandiswa mvura inobuda nesimba guru kuri kudiwa
clog-10: Matambudziko epombi inosangana netangi retsvina uye mvura iri kudzoka
clog-11: Kuvharika kwepombi yekurasa marara nekuda kwemafuta akaoma
clog-12: Kucheneswa kwetangi remafuta ekuresitorendi nekugadziriswa kwepombi
leak-1: Mvura iri kudonha kana kunyorovesa denga/madziro ezasi
leak-2: Mita yemvura iri kutenderera kunyange pasina mvura iri kushandiswa
leak-3: Pepa remadziro, pasi pemapuranga, kana mheti zvakanyorova uye zvine chakuvhuvhu
leak-4: Panosangana pombi nepombi yemvura panoramba pachidonha mvura
leak-5: Pasi pechimbuzi kana mune zvinoshanda mutangi racho mune mvura iri kubuda
leak-6: Pombi yemvura yakatsemuka nechando kana mita yakaoma nechando panguva yechando
leak-7: Mvura tsvuku ine ngura kana ivhu/tsvina iri kubuda mupombi
leak-8: Pombi dzebhoyira kana vharuvhu yekugovera kudziya iri kubuda mvura
leak-9: Kupinda kwemvura yemvura kuburikidza nekutsemuka kwemadziro ekunze kana sirikoni yehwindo
leak-10: Kutsvaga kubuda kwemvura kudiki kuchishandiswa zvinonzwa inzwi kana gasi zvepamusoro
leak-11: Kumanikidza kwemvura kwakanyanya kuderera, kudiwa pombi yekusimudzira kumanikidza
leak-12: Kutsiviwa kwepombi tsaru dzose nekudzivirirwa kwemvura pasi pebhavhu patsva
bl-1: Bhoyira rine magetsi akabatidzwa, asi kamuri harisi kudziya zvachose
bl-2: Hapana mvura inopisa panguva yekugeza, mvura inotonhora chete ndiyo inobuda
bl-3: Kodhi yekukanganisa iri kubwaira pakadzora tembiricha yemukati mekamuri
bl-4: Mvura iri kudonha kubva mukati mebhaira kana mumapombi epazasi
bl-5: Ruzha rukuru rwekugogodza kana kurira panotanga kushanda bhaira
bl-6: Hwema hwegasi kana hutsi hunobuda huri kupinda mukamuri
bl-7: Pombi inotenderedza yakanganisika; panonzwika mvura asi hapana kudziyisa
bl-8: Kukumbira mutengo webhaira idzva regasi recondensing rinozvichengetedza zvakatipoteredza
bl-9: Kadzora tembiricha yekamuri rega rega kakanganisika kana vharuvhu yekuita haisi kushanda
bl-10: Kusuka pombi yekudziyisa (kubvisa matope) nekuburitsa mweya zvinodiwa
bl-11: Kuongorora nekugadzirisa bhaira remafuta / remagetsi / remarasha
bl-12: Kunyungudutsa mapombi ebhaira akaoma nechando nekuisa patsva zvinodzivirira kutonhora
